subject: daemon: native task lifecycle pipeline (embed + blockedBy wires + judge seed on ingestion)
description:
Implement the core lifecycle function the daemon runs whenever it discovers new/changed native task files. The function takes a task key + file contents and:
1. Embeds the task (title + description → vec via existing embed() — ~5ms warm, already done for overlay tasks)
2. Parses blockedBy field → emits blocking edges into overlay (e.g. blockedBy:["3"] → add blocking edge from <session>/3 to this task)
3. Runs suggest_links on the task → seeds candidate context edges into /judge/next queue at weight 0 (judged:false)
4. Does NOT auto-wire suggest_links suggest_kind:"blocking" as hard blockers — those go into judge queue as context candidates only

This is the same pipeline overlay/followup tasks already go through. Native tasks currently bypass it (they arrive in buildGraph with no vec, no edges, no judge candidates). The function should be idempotent — safe to call on re-reads of already-processed tasks (skip if vec already set + edges already seeded).

Hook into: (a) the fs.watch callback at daemon.js line 184 as a passive fallback, and (b) the /sync/tasks endpoint (separate task) as the synchronous path.
